newsitem.title: USA: Merrill CEO sees bank-brokerage mergers.
newsitem.headline: Merrill CEO sees bank-brokerage mergers.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc's new Chairman and Chief Executive Officer David Komansky said on Tuesday that he expects more consolidation in the banking and brokerage industry.
"It's going to happen," Komansky told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
"We clearly feel that we could create more shareholder value by being independent," Komansky said.
Komansky said the brokerage industry would need regulatory relief before it could make acquisitions of banks.
Komansky said "banks could buy securities companies, but securities companies can not buy banks. That's an unfair playing field."
